boundFormat: t => { const x = t / 31557600; return (-x).toFixed(4) + ' ABY BBY'; }

setup.js: (() => { const s = document.getElementById('timeline-stage'); const r = s.getBoundingClientRect(); const now = Number(s.dataset.uiScale) || 1; const d = -Math.log(1.25 / now) / 0.002; s.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', { deltaY: d, ctrlKey: true, clientX: r.left + r.width / 2, clientY: r.top + 0.5 * r.height, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); })()
